clean_forward_timing: after the historical bundle is frozen and 2025 confirmation is complete, compute whether a legitimate Week 6 freeze (committed freeze + passing readiness) can occur BEFORE the first Week 6 eligible cutoff; if yes prepare Week 6 shadow capture, otherwise Week 7; never backdate

component_plan.COMPLETION: QB attempts -> completions: baseline = position / league shrunk completion rate vs contextual (player / team / opponent) hierarchical model
component_plan.EVENTS: passing TD, interception, rushing TD, receiving TD as opportunity-conditioned hazards (internally generated red-zone / scoring state where source quality allows; otherwise simpler opportunity rates, limitation labelled); anytime TD DERIVED from rushing + receiving TDs
component_plan.NEWCOMER: cfb_newcomer_state_contract.json: quantify the unseen-producer population; historical evaluation separates HISTORICALLY_OBSERVABLE_CANDIDATES from HISTORICALLY_UNOBSERVABLE_NEWCOMERS (never 100% coverage); forward universe admits timestamped live-roster players with zero prior appearances with wide high-uncertainty priors built only from supported data
component_plan.O2_role_family_carry_allocation: primary rushers (QB, RB, FB) share the pool N_primary = N_team_carries - G by a Dirichlet-multinomial / beta-binomial allocation with participation x share; WR / TE / other carries are a separate low-frequency residual process G | N ~ BetaBinomial, allocated among WR / TE candidates; carry conservation draw by draw. Compared with O1 B0 (retained) and O1 C1 (rejected, reference) on the SAME rows
component_plan.PASS_EFFICIENCY: attempts -> completions -> yards per completion (compound), complete passing-yards distribution
component_plan.QB_role: P(QB meaningful participation) x attempt-share allocation of team pass attempts (BetaBinomial), starter continuity and recent attempt share, multi-QB uncertainty, newcomer-QB prior; no target-game starter identity
component_plan.RECEIVING: (true targets BLOCKED) team completions -> receiver reception-share allocation (sum player receptions <= team completions with an explicit other-receiver residual) -> receptions -> yards per reception -> receiving yards; unseen / newcomer players eligible through high-uncertainty priors
component_plan.RUSH_EFFICIENCY: per-carry yards distribution (frozen play-event table), hierarchical shrinkage league -> position -> player, opponent adjustment from prior games only; ordinary / explosive split only if the event source proves it stable; rushing yards = compound of the carry distribution and the per-carry distribution (exact FFT convolution)
component_plan.SIMULATOR: cfb_phase1_sim.py (order: availability -> team plays -> pass / rush split -> QB participation -> carry / reception allocations -> attempts / completions -> efficiency outcomes -> TD / INT events -> team points -> result); accounting identities draw by draw; simulation N and convergence criteria registered in phase1b_simulator_registration.json BEFORE simulator scoring (CDF / Wasserstein stability for lattice outcomes)
component_plan.TARGET_RECOVERY_AUDIT: one bounded source-only audit (gate registered in phase1b_target_recovery_gate.json BEFORE results); verdict TRUE_TARGETS_RECOVERABLE or TRUE_TARGETS_NOT_RELIABLY_RECOVERABLE; if not reliable the target-based architecture is BLOCKED and receiving = team completions -> reception-share allocation -> receptions -> yards per reception -> receiving yards
component_plan.TEAM_SCORING: internal team points distribution from team offensive state, opponent state, volume, scoring efficiency, turnover state, home / neutral, internal strength; no sportsbook total / spread; legacy moneyline is a comparator only; win probability derived from the joint points distribution
component_plan.V2_team_volume: total offensive plays N ~ NB2; dropbacks D | N ~ BetaBinomial(N, pass share, kappa); rush R = N - D; sacks S | D ~ Binomial(D, sack rate); pass attempts A = D - S; identity R + A + S = N holds draw by draw. Compared on burned development with the independent T1 C1 / T2 B0 construction (marginals R and A, total N)

development_iteration_rule.failed_experiment_registry: phase1b_failed_experiments.json (append-only: every rejected architecture / branch is recorded with its reason and metrics; O1 C1 is entered as already FROZEN_REJECTED)

comparators: old champion models where outputs overlap
integrated_confirmation_2025.component_pass_rule: a component PASSES confirmation iff versus its simple baseline: primary loss not worse by more than 0.5%, NLL (or Brier) not worse by more than 0.5%, |relative mean bias| <= 5%, 80% / 90% interval coverage error <= 0.05, no eligible slice (>= 500 rows or >= 200 team-games) more than 10% worse
integrated_confirmation_2025.end_to_end_rule: accounting identities (carry conservation, receptions <= completions <= attempts, R + A + S = plays, TDs <= opportunities) hold in 100% of simulated draws; the engine is reported as passing / failing per component, never rescued
integrated_confirmation_2025.failure: if the frozen bundle fails it is recorded as failed; it is NOT altered and 2025 is NOT rescored
integrated_confirmation_2025.label: LATE_PERIOD_INTEGRATED_CONFIRMATION_PREVIOUSLY_EXPOSED
integrated_confirmation_2025.same_universe: the same candidate universe wherever possible; legacy rows outside the universe are reported separately
integrated_confirmation_2025.scored: once, per bundle hash, from the frozen bundle: every component, every outcome distribution, end-to-end player outcomes, team points, win probability
